q-usage-root-of-unity-undeclared.evidence: folio/quantum-observable-universe/braids-and-knots/reducible-reps.md:3 — root-of-unity construction used without explicit regime declaration — The PBW filtration on $\mathcal{U}_q(\mathfrak{su}(2))$ equips the associated graded algebra $\mathrm{gr}\mathcal{U}_q$ with a commutative product. A Groebner--Shirshov basis for the $q$-deformed relations exhibits $\mathcal{U}_q$ as a flat deformation of $\mathrm{gr}\mathcal{U}_q$. The leading monomials of the $q$-Serre relations provide non-overlapping obstructions whose resolution yields a normal-form basis coinciding with the Lusztig divided-power basis. In positive characteristic, this construction produces the distribution algebra $\mathrm{Dist}(G)$ of the lifted formal group $G$ as a deformation of the commutative $\mathrm{Dist}(H)$. The strong multiplicativity condition guarantees that the Frobenius relation is preserved at every filtration degree.
